items.title: Paul Barnes Interview, 1971-03-13
items.q: On bass we had Eddie Barrera.

ctx.x: Now we formed a band ourselves.

And I don't want to make it too long but I'll tell you some of the members of the band. On drumming we had Si Frasier, Josiah Frasier on drumming. On bass we had Eddie Barrera. On piano we had Mercedes Fields. On the trumpet we had Bush Hall. Well Bush Hall died and he was replaced with Red Alam. He had Red Alam. He had Darius Ballera. Darius Ballera. Darius Ballera. Darius Ballera.

items.title: Eddie Marrero Interview, 1961-10-11
items.q: I guess just Paul was in it then.

ctx.x: A whole lot of people couldn't get in there. Really had a good time. Get in there, you see what I mean? Sure. There'd be more people outside than the inside. They'd be begging. They won't pay you to get in like that. So I got a many of them in for nothing. There's God. Sometime I'll get five and six of them in there at a banquet. That was good time.

I was going to ask a little more about the, the, the, the, the, the, the, the playing, actually playing the bass. I know you were over there at the Autocrat Club a couple of years ago when they were rehearsing with Lawrence and the Barnes Brothers and all. I guess just Paul was in it then. And you were talking about in the old days, we used to bow most of the time that even when you played, you used to bow a good deal? Yeah.
Bow a good deal. Such as waltzes, charlices, of course they don't play that.
